messages.subject: Second-order latent factor growth curve models
parts:
Hello,

Is it possible to fit second-order latent factor growth curve models in lavaan? Or is this only possible in other software (e.g., Mplus)? 

(I’ve attached a screenshot of the type of model I’m referring to)

Thank you,
Michaela

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Second-order latent factor growth curve models
parts: Is it possible to fit second-order latent factor growth curve models in lavaan?

Yes, any standard SEM software that can estimate mean and covariance structure (MACS) can fit those models.  They are standard MACS models.
